p: Nebo: These were cities of the Moabites, which Nebuchadnezzar took before he went to fight against Nebo King of Egypt.
come: Thus shall the Babylonians encourage one another.
O Madmen: Read Isa 25:10.
Luhith continual weeping shall go up: Horonaim and Luhith were two places by which the Moabites would flee, Isa 15:5.
bush in the wilderness: Hide yourselves in barren places, where the enemy will not pursue after you, Jer 17:6.
works and in thy treasures: That is, the idols which are the works your hands. Some read, in your possessions, for so the word may signify as in 1Sa 25:2.
Chemosh shall go forth into captivity: Both your great idol and his maintainers will be led away captives so that they will then know that it is in vain to look for help at idols, Isa 15:2.

Cursed be he that doeth the: He shows that God would punish the Chaldeans if they did not destroy the Egyptians, and that with a courage, and calls this executing of his vengeance against his enemies, his work though the Chaldeans sought another end, Isa 10:11.
emptied from vessel to vessel: Has not been removed as the Jews have, but have lived at ease, and as a wine that feeds itself on his lees.
Bethel their confidence: As the calf of Bethel was not able to deliver the Israelites no more will Chemosh deliver the Moabites.
How is the strong staff broken: How are they destroyed that put their trust in their strength and riches?
Moab is confounded: Thus they who flee will answer.
horn of Moab is cut off: That is, his power and strength.
drunk: He willed the Chaldeans to lay afflictions enough on them till they are like drunken men that fall down to their shame and are derided by all.
leap for joy: You rejoiced to hear of his misery, Isa 16:6.
but it shall not be so: He will not execute his malice against his neighbours.
Therefore will I wail for Moab: Read Isa 16:7.
of Jazer: Which city was in the utmost border of Moab: and by this he signifies that the whole land would be destroyed and the people carried away.
heifer of three years old: Read Geneva "Isa 15:5"
pipes: Their custom was to play on flutes or instruments, heavy and grave tunes at burials and in the time of mourning, as in Mt 9:23.
he shall fly as an eagle: That is, Nebuchadnezzar, as in Jer 49:22.
Fear: He that escapes one danger will be taken by another, Isa 24:17.
of Heshbon because of the force: They fled there thinking to have comfort from the Amorites.
a fire shall come out of: The Amorites had destroyed the Moabites in times past, and now because of their power the Moabites will seek them for help.
Chemosh perisheth: Who vaunted themselves of their idol as though he could have defended them.
latter days: That is, they will be restored by the Messiah.
